clue.text: Bread in test case exhibited in court

indicators.note: the word for bread sits inside the word for a test case

parts.note: a trial is a test, as of a case or a product
a bun is a small bread roll

explanation.surface: A loaf of bread produced as evidence during a court case.
explanation.definitionFit: A tribunal is a body sitting in judgement, a kind of court.

clue.text: Do a rush job on the roof?

definitions.text: Do a rush job on the roof?

parts.words: Do a rush job on the roof
parts.note: a rush job is normally a hurried one, but here it is work done with rushes, the reeds laid on a roof

explanation.surface: A builder hurrying through a roofing job.
explanation.definitionFit: Covering a roof with rushes or reeds is the craft of roofing in straw and reed.

clue.text: One's king set up a republic

parts.note: one is I, and the 's stands for is, giving I then S

indicators.note: in a down clue, set up means the king's name is written upwards, back to front

parts.note: Lear is Shakespeare's king

explanation.surface: A single monarch founding a republic, which is a contradiction.
explanation.definitionFit: Israel is a state governed as a parliamentary republic, so it is an example of one.

clue.text: Such a steak is rarely served

definitions.text: Such a steak is rarely served

parts.words: Such a steak is rarely served
parts.note: rarely seems to mean seldom, but it means cooked rare, so the steak is barely cooked

explanation.surface: A remark that restaurants seldom serve a certain kind of steak.
explanation.definitionFit: Meat served rare is not cooked through, that is, lightly cooked.

clue.text: Initial repetition is only repetition after all

indicators.note: after places the word for repetition behind the word all

parts.note: taken as written
iteration is doing something again, a repetition

explanation.surface: A wry comment that a device of repeated first letters is just repetition after all.
explanation.definitionFit: Alliteration is the repeating of the same initial sound in neighbouring words.

clue.text: A boring set-up

parts.note: boring seems to mean dull, but it means drilling, and the set-up is the drilling platform at sea

explanation.surface: A complaint about a dull arrangement.
explanation.definitionFit: An offshore drilling platform bores into the seabed for petroleum.

clue.text: Girl has half an hour in a state

parts.note: Ida is a girl's name

indicators.note: half an hour keeps the first two of its four letters

explanation.surface: A girl is in a bad emotional state for thirty minutes.
explanation.definitionFit: Idaho is one of the fifty US states.

clue.text: Cancels order for windscreens — not new

indicators.note: putting letters in a new order signals rearranging the letters of windscreens
not tells us the letters of the word new must be taken away from the mix

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone calls off an order placed for car windscreens.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove N, E and W from WINDSCREENS, as 'not' asks, and rearrange IDSCRENS, as 'order for' asks.
explanation.definitionFit: To rescind an order or law is to revoke or annul it, i.e. to cancel it.

clue.text: Gallery finds finales welcome surprises

parts.note: the gods is the highest gallery of a theatre
finales are endings, ends

explanation.surface: An art gallery is pleased with what it discovers at the end.
explanation.walkthrough: The gods is a theatre's top gallery, not an art gallery.
explanation.definitionFit: A godsend is an unexpected stroke of good fortune, something arriving as if sent from heaven.

clue.text: Big dog very good about change of lead

parts.note: A1 means first-rate, written here as A and I
re means about or concerning

indicators.note: a change of the word lead rearranges its letters

explanation.surface: A large, well-behaved dog getting a new lead.
explanation.walkthrough: 'change of' turns LEAD into DALE. A1 is taken as the letters A and I.
explanation.definitionFit: The Airedale is the largest of the terrier breeds, a big dog from Yorkshire.

clue.text: Highly bred?

parts.note: highly bred suggests aristocratic, but read as bred and also lifted high

explanation.surface: A question whether someone is of noble breeding.
explanation.definitionFit: Raised means both brought up (bred) and lifted higher.

clue.text: News handout of journalists' redundancy

parts.note: the press means journalists collectively
being made redundant is a release from one's job

explanation.surface: A newspaper announcing the layoff of its journalists.
explanation.definitionFit: A statement issued to the media is an official handout of news.

clue.text: The church always brings comfort

parts.note: CH is the abbreviation for church
e'er is a poetic short form of ever, meaning always

explanation.surface: Faith offers lasting consolation.
explanation.definitionFit: To cheer someone up is to comfort them; as a noun it is solace or encouragement.

clue.text: Drunken roisterer to frighten people badly

indicators.note: drunken suggests the letters are staggering about out of order

explanation.surface: A drunken reveller scaring people.
explanation.definitionFit: To terrorise is to fill people with great fear, often by threats or violence.

clue.text: Wrote and agreed

definitions.meaning: matched or was consistent with something

explanation.definitionFit: The verb covers both writing letters back and forth and being in agreement or matching.

clue.text: Performance in the theatre switched to open air

indicators.note: switched means the letters are swapped around into a new order

explanation.surface: A stage show moved from indoors to an outdoor venue.
explanation.walkthrough: The theatre is the operating theatre, not a playhouse.
explanation.definitionFit: Surgery carried out in an operating theatre is a medical procedure, a performance there.

clue.text: A spot of capital punishment

parts.note: a spot seems to mean a little, but it is the place where executions happen

explanation.surface: A light-hearted phrase for a small dose of execution.
explanation.definitionFit: The platform on which criminals were hanged or beheaded was the site of executions.

clue.text: I am on the way — the way forward

parts.note: I'm is the contraction of I am
a mode is a way or manner of doing
ST is the abbreviation for street, a way

explanation.surface: Someone announcing they are on their way and setting the course ahead.
explanation.definitionFit: Forward in the sense of bold or presumptuous is a synonym of shameless.

clue.text: They may be running the moment race is organised

indicators.note: organised means the letters are put into a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: A race being set up at this very moment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'running' looks like part of the race, but refers to a running commentary.
explanation.definitionFit: A running commentary is a live spoken description given as events happen.

clue.text: Idle Jack leads, fuming

indicators.note: leads puts the sailor's word in front of the word for idling

parts.note: a jack tar is a sailor, AB being an able seaman
to laze is to idle

explanation.surface: A lazy man called Jack is angrily walking the dogs.
explanation.definitionFit: Something fuming is giving off smoke, as something on fire does.

clue.text: Course at Oxford is after credit when in trouble

indicators.note: is after places the Oxford river behind the credit abbreviation

parts.note: CR is the accounting abbreviation for credit
the Isis is the name of the River Thames as it flows through Oxford

explanation.surface: A student at Oxford in money trouble after running up credit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Course' is a watercourse, not a study course.
explanation.definitionFit: A crisis is a time of serious difficulty or danger.

clue.text: Pays for implement to make furniture

parts.note: to foot the bill is to pay for it
a tool is an implement

explanation.surface: Someone buys a tool to build furniture.
explanation.definitionFit: A low stool for resting the feet is a piece of furniture.

clue.text: Good man in charge, with love at heart, makes a good bearer

indicators.note: at heart places the love symbol in the middle of the other pieces

parts.note: ST, saint, is a good man
love is zero in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: A kindly, loving boss who carries his burdens well.
explanation.definitionFit: A stoic endures hardship without complaint, bearing it well.

clue.text: Fossil resin that should be approached with caution

definitions.meaning: hardened ancient tree resin used in jewellery

definitions.text: that should be approached with caution
definitions.meaning: the traffic light between green and red, warning drivers to prepare to stop

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a fossilised resin and the cautionary traffic signal.

clue.text: State some foregone conclusion

indicators.note: some means only part of these words is used, letters sitting inside them

explanation.surface: A statement that something is a certain outcome.
explanation.walkthrough: 'State' looks like a verb, but is the definition, a US state.
explanation.definitionFit: It is one of the US states, on the Pacific coast.

clue.text: Head south for the main cities

parts.note: a capital is the head or top of a column

explanation.surface: Advice to travel south to find the big cities.
explanation.definitionFit: A capital is a country's or region's chief city, seat of government.

clue.text: Part the cad needed to play

indicators.note: to play with letters is to move them about into a new order

explanation.surface: A theatre role that needs a villain to act it.
explanation.definitionFit: To detach is to separate or part one thing from another.

clue.text: Repairmen take in article in turns

indicators.note: take in means the repairmen word holds the article inside it

parts.note: menders are people who repair things
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: Mechanics taking turns over a newspaper article.
explanation.definitionFit: A river that meanders winds back and forth, making many turns.
